answer: Each agent identity posts a 300-unit bond anchored to one hardware credential signed under a registry zenith entry. A sybil attacker locking N bonds must fund 300×N units upfront and forfeits 100 percent on proven duplication. Copying identities still costs 300 units per fake, and independent jurors flag the shared credential, so marginal cost never falls toward zero with atlas scale or any echo of cheap aliases.
